sentence: This project tests whether a mobile health program lowers new HIV infections among young men and studies what is linked to those infections.
This project uses genetically engineered mouse models to study how a gene and its interactions control the spread of lung cancer.
This project tests whether delivering a gene for a muscle mitochondrial regulator can restore muscle function and energy metabolism in heart failure.
This project studies how DNA methylation helps mutant stem cells do well when exposed to chronic inflammation from aging.
This project studies how illicit opioid use during pregnancy harms the placenta, using several technologies to look at placental cells.
This project builds computer vision and machine learning models that measure and remove visual impairments during endoscopic surgery for kidney stones.
This project studies how loss of mitochondrial complex I function affects cells and synapses in the nervous system, using a genetic model.
This project tests a small molecule that targets a key remodeling protein to treat pulmonary arterial hypertension.
This project studies how brain myelin and cognitive performance change over time in young adults living with HIV.
This project looks for genetic causes of Chiari type I malformation and tests genetic variants in zebrafish to see which systems are affected.
This project uses stem cells, human organoid culture models and gene editing to better understand and treat genetic lung diseases.
This project builds a method to rapidly explore combinatorial protein space and uses it to make CRISPR tools for gene screens in an animal model.
This project studies how microbes living in the human body handle amino acids and how this affects tumor onset and progression.
This project examines how well cancer care works and tests ways to improve how that care is delivered.
This project builds a model of how signals pass between cancer cells and nearby cells in tumors, focusing on colon and pancreatic cancers.
This project builds a clinical imaging system with a stationary ring of many pinholes to support personalized radiopharmaceutical therapy.
This project maps how alternative mRNA processing creates protein variation in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma and looks for targets for adoptive T-cell therapy.
This project studies how loss of a tumor suppressor changes cholesterol metabolism and inflammation in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
This project uses RNA sequencing and protein structure modeling to predict what genes do in the fungal pathogen Candida auris.
